purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA standard medical receipt (claim) software. It performs point-score aggregation and editing for medical treatment categories (診療区分別点数集計), building and editing receipt (レセプト) data including insurance combinations, co-payment amounts, prescription fees, and various medical procedure classifications. It is a large batch processing component that computes and formats receipt claim records for submission.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims)

verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains Shift-JIS encoded Japanese text (visible as mojibake in the truncated header). The program is clearly genuine production COBOL from the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system. The absence of COMP-3 is notable for a numeric-heavy billing program but may reflect the specific COBOL runtime (GnuCOBOL) or coding conventions used by this project. The 1.1 MB size and 23,418 lines make this one of the larger single COBOL source files.
